objective: Develop dedicated V1-derived Satellite strategies for SUI/NEAR/UNI/AAVE/BCH that profitably fill protected Core idle periods in one shared 250-USDC account.
rules: each Satellite is diagnosed and evolved independently
original V1/DMS_V1 is the only initial strategy seed
Core V6 profiles may be studied later only as evidence, never copied as the default Satellite starting point
one causal change family per experiment
coverage and trade count do not compensate for negative after-cost shared performance
protected Core product must remain unchanged until full promotion gates pass

hypotheses.claim: The unchanged original Hixton V1/DMS_V1 provides the neutral measurement baseline needed to identify why each of the five Satellite markets succeeds or fails as a short Core-idle filler.
